newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Great Central holds year gold forecast.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Great Central holds year gold forecast.

text.p: Great Central Mines NL on Tuesday held its gold production forecast for 1996/97 at 550,000 ounces, despite lower than expected production in the quarter to December 31, 1996.
Great Central said it produced 104,084 ounces for the quarter at an average cast operating cost of A$265 an ounce.

Jundee produced 86 percent of forecast mine production due to difficulties with trucks and excavators supplied by contractors, it said. The Bronzewing mine also experieneced production delays following the discovery of further mineralisation which required extra development work.
Great Central had forecast second quarter production of 130,000 ounces from its two Western Australian mines.
The mineral resource estimate was increased 1.6 million ounces during the quarter, made up of 1.0 million ounces at Jundee Barton Deeps and 0.6 million ounces at Bronzewing.
Jundee had resources of 2.75 million ounces and Bronzewing 3.60 million ounces, for a total 6.35 million ounces, Great Central said in its second quarter production report.
Proven and probable reserves were increased by 200,000 ounces to a total 2.6 milion ounces from 24.6 million tonnes at an average grade of 3.3 grams per tonne.
Gold sales for the quarter totalled 112,528 ounces at an average price of A$543 an ounce.
Great Central said the Bronzewing mill would have an increased capacity of two million tonnes a year from February, 1997.
A decision to expand mill capacity at Jundee would be considered in mid-1997 to take into account the impact of high grade ore from Barton Deeps.
